title: Senior Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**Elements Green \- That's who we are** 




 Elements Green is a UK\-based, international solar and BESS investor and developer, headquartered in Mayfair, London, with a pedigree dating back to 2008\. EG has established a global footprint and a strong reputation for being at the forefront of technological and commercial evolution within the renewable energy sector. With greenfield development teams in the UK, Italy, Germany and Australia, we are capable of taking ownership of the development process, from origination through to construction, connection and operation.
 



  





 As we continue to expand our project portfolio in Elements Green Deutschland GmbH, we are looking for a Senior Engineer
 
 (m/f/d) focused on BESS and Grid projects in full\-time to support these projects across the full lifecycle — from development and construction to operation.
 



  





**Summary of the role and key responsibilities** 



* Take ownership of the technical design for utility\-scale BESS projects from feasibility to "Ready\-to\-Build".
* Manage the entire grid connection process (MV/HV), interfacing directly with DSOs and TSOs, ensuring compliance with VDE\-AR\-N 4110/4120/4130\.
* Validate and approve technical concepts, single\-line diagrams (SLDs), and layout designs.
* Asses, approve and create requirement specifications for the entire components within the electrical balance of plant
* Prepare decision material for the management team on procurement decisions and technology scouting.
* Implement and maintain technical standards to ensure all projects are "Audit\-Ready" for investors and authorities.
* Handle internal and external stakeholders of our projects.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence.



  





**Key Requirements** 



* Degree in Electrical Engineering (B.Sc./M.Sc.), Power Systems, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of professional experience in renewable energy project engineering; specific experience with BESS or large\-scale PV is a must.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of German grid codes, permitting processes, and technical standards.
* Highly analytical mindset with strong decision\-making capabilities and a solution\-oriented approach.
* Fluency in German and English is mandatory due to regulatory requirements and international partners.



  





**Exciting prospects at Elements Green Deutschland GmbH** 




**Modern office \|** 
 Located in the heart of Hamburg near the central station, our modern workplace offers high\-quality equipment and an inspiring environment that supports productive and comfortable working.
 



  





**Work\-life balance** 
 \| With flexible working hours and the option to work from home, we create the ideal framework for you to combine your job, family and free time.
 



  





**Flat hierarchies** 
 \| Thanks to our flexible start\-up structures and fast decision\-making processes, you will enjoy a great deal of creative freedom.
 



  





**Independent working style** 
 \| We approach the responsibility you are given with a fundamental trust in your professional and social skills.
 



  





**Personal Health \|** 
 With bike leasing and Wellpass, we support your physical wellbeing and help you stay active and balanced in your everyday life.
 



  





**Deutschlandticket \|** 
 We support your daily commute and enable flexible and sustainable mobility throughout Germany.
 



  





**Meaningful activities** 
 \| With your new job at Elements Green Deutschland GmbH, you will not only make an important contribution to the success of the energy transition, but you will also play a significant role in shaping a sustainably secure future.
 



  





**Arrive and progress** 
 \| In addition to a friendly induction process, we offer you exciting career prospects in a diverse, internationally active team.
